messages:
ana (evals): Quick alert: onboarding tsunami-v1-q3 shows a reproducible translation quality drop on our mixed zh+ar subtitle set. BLEU -6, chrF -0.11 on the subset. Looks tied to punctuation/number handling at script boundaries. :exclamation:

hiro (eng-ml): only q3 variant or also fp16?

ana (evals): fp16 baseline was clean. Regression appears only after the q3 export path (quant + tokenizer minify). Example below.

```
src: "\u7b2c7\u7ae0\u3000- \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0635\u0631 7: \u0645\u062c\u0645\u0648\u0639"
ref: "\u7b2c7\u7ae0 - \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0635\u0631 7: \u0645\u062c\u0645\u0648\u0639"
tsunami-v1-fp16: "\u7b2c7\u7ae0 - \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0635\u0631 7: \u0645\u062c\u0645\u0648\u0639"
tsunami-v1-q3: "\u7b2c7\u7ae0 \u200e- \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0635\u0631 7: \u0645\u062c\u0645\u0648\u0639"
```

ana (evals): Notice the LTR mark (\u200e) inserted before the hyphen and a missing thinspace in CJK cluster in q3 output.

peter (quant): q3 export used token-table compression + normalize_digits=true + combine_punct heuristic. Might be the combine_punct reordering after compression.

sam (serving): runtime canary logs show `kvcache: offset_mismatch expected=44 actual=40 seq=11` on that request id; also `decoder: unexpected_delim id=0` once.

viv (infra): export job: `EXPORT tsunami-v1 -> q3 (compress_tok=true, normalize_digits=true, combine_punct=true) OK` at 3123456790. No CI failures. Canary logs with kv warnings at 3123456802.

ana (evals): token dumps: 
```
# fp16 tokens: ['\u7b2c','7','\u7ae0','\u3000','-',' ','\u0627\u0644\u0628\u0635\u0631',' ','7',':',' ','\u0645\u062c\u0645\u0648\u0639']
# q3 tokens: ['\u7b2c','7','\u7ae0','\u3000','\u200e','-',' ','\u0627\u0644\u0628\u0635\u0631',' ','7',':',' ','\u0645\u062c\u0645\u0648\u0639']
```

peter (quant): looks like a normalization pass is inserting an LTR mark and shifting token boundaries by one, producing a zero token in the tokenizer fallback at that index. Could break kv indexing.

hiro (eng-ml): customer impact: partner Z ingests subtitles and relies on the exact spacing around chapter markers. This would shift timestamps and break their parser. We need to halt rollout.

sam (serving): pausing q3 routing in all regions for tsunami-v1 now. Routing -> fp16 at 3123456805.

peter (quant): bisect plan: reproduce with and without compress_tok, without combine_punct, and without normalize_digits. I'll run `scripts/exp_bisect_tok.sh tsunami-v1 --variants compress,combine,normalize` and diff tokenID streams and kv offset maps.

viv (infra): enabling extra token<->kv debug logs for canary traffic for next 6h.

ana (evals): i'll run a focused eval slice that filters for (CJK chapter markers + inline Arabic numerals/punctuation) and post BLEU/chrF deltas.

hiro (eng-ml): good. once peter has the bisect result we can decide to revert the compress or normalize toggles. For now keep fp16 as default.

notif-bot: rollback executed: tsunami-v1-q3 routing -> fp16 by sam at 3123456805

ana (evals): summary: q3 export caused LTR mark insertion and token boundary shift for mixed CJK+Arabic subtitles, kv offset mismatches seen, rollback applied. Actions: bisect export transforms (peter), focused eval slice (ana), enable extra kv logging (viv).
